decision_contract.universe: every exact h0 dependency/importer candidate exactly once
classification_order: no exact production-reachable external operation => exclude_not_production_reachable
one exact reachable nominal owner flow => admit_nominal
one exact reachable functional owner flow => admit_functional
zero live owner flows after closed exclusions => terminal_unresolved
multiple competing live owner flows => terminal_multiple
owner_flow_authority: exact local construction or returned closure chain
exact consumer storage and production operation
nominal struct interface function field returned named function or method value
decision_contract.no_struct_wrapper_rule: absence of a direct sdk-bearing struct is neither admission nor exclusion
decision_contract.ambiguity_rule: collect every unresolved disposition then reject the complete h1 without partial semantic output

bounded_evidence_extensions: when old configuration evidence is empty retain an exact typed configuration composite passed to the chosen constructor
when old verification evidence is empty require an exact test owner construction or factory operation and later assertion over result error or collaborator state
when old observability evidence is empty require one exact invoked interface method and one compatible production implementation that mutates retained state or invokes a logging sink

forbidden: product report integration on this evidence alone
